```{r}

library(janitor)
library(magrittr)
library(effsize)
```

```{r functions, include=FALSE}
source(file="functions_bal_macrophages.R")
source(file="initialize_bal_data.R")
```



Part of the argument of the enrichment of gene scores in the paper Wendisch, Dietrich,.. et. al is implicitly based on a comparison of p-values between cell clusters on a cell to cell basis. One of the problems with arguing "significance" here is that the p-value in a wilcoxon test is a function to sample size( not cell number is a pseudo sample size as the number of cells per donor varies). Since group sizes vary over one order of magnitude, it is possible that the conclusions are skewed, with higher p-values atributed to larger cell clusters.

```{r}
BAL_macrophages$Cluster %>% table()
```

In order to get a first impression of this skew, the following analysis should compare the results of the paper with p-values from equal sample sizes attained through downsampling the Seurat object. Later on measures of effect size should be added to the analysis to be enable conclusions about ~degree of related~.
Since module scores of genesets from fibrosis papers are not commpared to other (reference-)genesets the question that can be answered  is
"Given a number of genesets from macrophage subtypes in fibrosis, which genesets are the most similar to covid-19 BAL macrophages cellcluster"

To be able to state that a cell cluster is fibrosis-associated a comparion has to be made to BAL genesets from other states such as COPD, cancer, other infections, rheumatic diseaes etc.

However a more tentative statement can be made by comparing the cell scores to reference genesets from the same data such as cluster defining genes etc.

## ..1. UMAP embedding with cell-based scores


```{r ,fig.width = 18, fig.height = 12}
Idents(BAL_macrophages) <- "Cluster"
set.seed(300)
BAL_macrophages_small_1 <- subset(BAL_macrophages, downsample=150)



BAL_macrophages <- add_named_module_score( 
  seurat_object   = BAL_macrophages, 
  genesets_list_named = genesets_covid %>% lapply(function(x) ensemblizer(x)),
  score_id = "score_cov"
  )
BAL_macrophages_small_1 <- add_named_module_score( 
  seurat_object   = BAL_macrophages_small_1, 
  genesets_list_named = genesets_covid %>% lapply(function(x) ensemblizer(x)),
  score_id = "score_cov"
  )



scores_cov <- BAL_macrophages@meta.data[, which(
  stringr::str_detect(string = names(BAL_macrophages@meta.data), pattern = "score_cov")
  )]

scores_cov_small_1 <- BAL_macrophages_small_1@meta.data[, which(
  stringr::str_detect(string = names(BAL_macrophages_small_1@meta.data), pattern = "score_cov")
  )]
```

## ..2. Violin plots as cluster-based population summaries


```{r}
# Re-shape data
data_cov <- extract_score_data(
  seurat_obj = BAL_macrophages, 
  scores=scores_cov, 
  score_id = "score_cov") %>% 
  mutate(Cluster= factor(Cluster, levels=cluster_names))

data_cov_small_1 <- extract_score_data(seurat_obj = BAL_macrophages_small_1, scores_ = scores_cov_small_1, score_id = "score_cov")%>% 
  mutate(Cluster= factor(Cluster, levels=cluster_names))
```

```{r}
ps_cov <- wilcox_cluster_to_rest(data = data_cov, geneset_var = "Geneset", "Cluster")
ps_cov_small_1 <- wilcox_cluster_to_rest(data = data_cov_small_1, geneset_var = "Geneset", "Cluster")
```


```{r,fig.width = 18, fig.height = 12}
# Plot
limits <- c(-0.5,1)

ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = data_cov,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x    = Cluster,
    y    = Score,
    col  = col,
    fill = Cluster
  )
) +score_violin_theme(limits = limits, p_score = ps_cov)#
# Save plot
# ggplot2::ggsave(
#   "BAL-macrophages_COVID-19-geneset-score-violins.png", width = 18, height = 12
# )
ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = data_cov_small_1,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x    = Cluster,
    y    = Score,
    col  = col,
    fill = Cluster
  )
) +score_violin_theme(limits = limits,ps_cov_small_1)#
# Save plot
# ggplot2::ggsave(
#   "BAL-macrophages_small_1__COVID-19-geneset-score-violins.png", width = 18, height = 12
# )

```

```{r}


library(VennDiagram)



SET1 <- genesets_fibrosis$`Mors_1SPP1+MIPF`
SET2 <- genesets_fibrosis$Reyf_MCluster1
SET3 <- genesets_fibrosis$Ayau_IPFeMp



v <- venn.diagram(list(SET1 = SET1, SET2 = SET2, SET3 = SET3),
                  fill = c("red", "green","blue"),
                  alpha = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), cat.cex = 1.5, cex=1.5,
                  filename=NULL)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(v)


v[[7]]$label  <- paste(setdiff(SET1, intersect(SET2,SET3)), collapse="\n") 
v[[8]]$label <- paste(setdiff(intersect(SET1,SET2),intersect(SET1, intersect(SET2,SET3))), collapse="\n")
v[[9]]$label <- paste(setdiff(SET2, intersect(SET1,SET3)), collapse="\n")
v[[10]]$label <- paste(setdiff(intersect(SET3,SET1),intersect(SET3, intersect(SET1,SET2))), collapse="\n")
v[[11]]$label <- paste(intersect(SET1, intersect(SET2,SET3)), collapse="\n")
v[[12]]$label <- paste(setdiff(intersect(SET2,SET3),intersect(SET2, intersect(SET1,SET3))), collapse="\n")
v[[13]]$label <- paste(setdiff(SET3, intersect(SET1,SET2)), collapse="\n")


grid.newpage()
grid.draw(v)
```

```{r}
overlap_set <- c("LILRB4","CTSZ", "APOE", "MMP9", "CCL2","CHIT1","CD14", "FNIP2", "SPP1", "LGMN","CD84","SDC2", "GPNMB")
overlap_set_lst <- list("overlap_set"= overlap_set %>% ensemblizer_2())

BAL_macrophages <- add_named_module_score(seurat_object =  BAL_macrophages,genesets_list_named = overlap_set_lst, score_id = "cust")

FeaturePlot(BAL_macrophages, features = "overlap_set_cust")
VlnPlot(BAL_macrophages, features = "overlap_set_cust")
dot_plot_cluster(genes_sorted = overlap_set)

```

```{r}
donor_clus_avg_scores_overlap_set <- tibble(overlap_set_cust=BAL_macrophages$overlap_set_cust )%>%  mutate(
            Cluster= as_factor(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$Cluster),
            donor=as_factor(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$patient)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("overlap_set"),names_to = "Geneset", values_to = "Score") %>% 
  group_by(Cluster,donor, Geneset) %>% summarise(Score=mean(Score))%>% 
  mutate(Cluster= factor(Cluster, levels=cluster_names),
         Geneset=str_replace_all(Geneset, pattern= "_score_fibrosis", replacement = "") %>% factor())

ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = donor_clus_avg_scores_overlap_set,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x    = Cluster,
    y    = Score,
    color = Cluster
  )
) +geom_jitter()+
  facet_wrap(vars(Geneset))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90))

cohens_d_module_ovelap_setr <- tibble(geneset=character(),cluster=character(),cohens_d=numeric())
data <- donor_clus_avg_scores_overlap_set
for (gs in levels(data$Geneset)) {
  #print(gs)
  for (clus in levels(data$Cluster) ) { #data %>% filter(Geneset==gs) %>% pull(Cluster) %>% unique()
    #print(clus)
    ctrl <- data%>% filter(Geneset==gs, Cluster!=clus) %>% pull(Score)
    treat <- data%>% filter(Geneset==gs, Cluster==clus) %>% pull(Score)
    d <- cohen.d(treat, ctrl)
    cohens_d_module_ovelap_setr %<>%  add_row(geneset=gs,cluster=clus,cohens_d=d$estimate)
  }
}

two_highest_os <- donor_clus_avg_scores_overlap_set %>% group_by(Geneset, Cluster) %>% summarise(mean_score=mean(Score)) %>% top_n(wt=mean_score,2) %>% ungroup() %>%  mutate(rank="highest")%>% clean_names()
n_highest_os <- (two_highest_os$rank=="highest") %>% sum()



p_avg_scores_t_os <- t_test_cluster_to_rest(donor_clus_avg_scores_overlap_set)%>% arrange(p.value)

dat <- p_avg_scores_t_os %>% clean_names() %>% 
  left_join(cohens_d_module_ovelap_setr,by = c("geneset", "cluster")) %>% arrange(-p_adjust) %>% left_join(two_highest_os,by = c("geneset", "cluster"))%>% mutate(p_adjust_highest=if_else(rank=="highest", p_value*n_highest_os, NULL)) %>% mutate(sig=if_else(p_adjust_highest<0.05,"sig","not sig.")) %>% arrange(p_adjust_highest) %>% mutate(cluster= factor(cluster, levels = names(color.cluster)))


dat%>% ggplot()+geom_tile(aes(x=geneset, y=cluster, fill=cohens_d)) +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90))+scale_fill_viridis_c()+geom_point(data =(dat %>% filter(!is.na(sig))) ,aes(x=geneset, y=cluster,color=sig))+scale_color_manual(values = c("not sig"="grey", "sig"="black"))+ scale_y_discrete(names(color.cluster))
```
